name: lurid-dreaming-at-the-opponents-end-phase-wakes-the-champion-and-draws-into-memory
notes: Timing restrictions ('Activate this card only during ...') were either absent or compared against phase codes the engine never reports (the end-phase opportunity window runs as BEOP, not END), and the $cardActivatedPrereqs table they were generated into was never consulted. Prereqs now live in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php and are enforced by ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce / CanActivateCardForSelection. (Lurid Dreaming's 'END' check could never be true, so it was never playable.) The drawn card returns to hand at recollection.

rulesClauses: Activate this card only during an opponent's end phase. Wake up your champion. If you do, draw a card into your memory.

engineBug.summary: Lurid Dreaming and Orchestrated Seizure compared the phase against 'END', which the end-phase opportunity window never reports (BEOP), so they could never be activated.
